reviews.title: So close to great

This causes me to pause in my learning to make the video navigate while I am actively following along. This wastes my time and attention to the content. This one change to their codec would make learning so much more efficient.

reviews.title: Disappointing Experience with LinkedIn Learning’s App and Support
reviews.text:
I recently completed a full course on the LinkedIn Learning iOS app, with every video marked as completed. I was even prompted to share my certificate on LinkedIn — but after clicking, I received an error message. When I reopened the app, the course suddenly appeared incomplete, despite all modules showing as completed.

I've contacted support multiple times, but instead of investigating the issue or escalating it, they repeatedly ask if I skipped any videos — even though I’ve provided clear evidence (green checkmarks and all). This seems to be a known bug affecting other users as well, yet support continues to follow a script instead of addressing the root cause.

As a paying subscriber, I expected better from a Microsoft-owned platform. Users shouldn't have to chase down certificates or beg support to acknowledge technical issues. Until this is fixed, I’d caution others before investing time and money here.

reviews.title: Poor Video Navigation UI
reviews.text: The content of the app is great, but the on screen video navigation buttons are not well thought through and difficult to see. The Play, fast forward, and skip buttons are all solid white. When you are viewing content that also has a white background (which is most videos), you cannot see these buttons because they are the same color. This issue can be easily remedied by adding a drop shadow or colored outline to the navigation buttons or adding the pause, fast forward, or skip buttons to the bottom of the video.

The video controls should be in the lower left corner.
